playbook.note: No Bulgarian file exists for the Playbooks plugin. Transliteration keeps the association with the untranslated product name; 'сценарий' is a possible native alternative but loses that link. Plural: плейбукове.

run.note: Noun ('a run of a playbook'). Verb: 'изпълни' / 'стартирай' ('Изпълни плейбука' for Run playbook). Plural: изпълнения.

status update.note: Status = 'състояние' and update = 'актуализация' per established webapp usage. Post update = 'Публикувай актуализация'.

retrospective.note: Standard Bulgarian agile term ('ретроспектива на спринта').

follower.note: Follow/Unfollow buttons: 'Следвай' (established in webapp) / 'Спри да следваш'.

trigger.note: Noun. Related established term: trigger word = 'задействаща дума' (webapp); verb 'задейства'. 'тригер' is the common Bulgarian IT noun.

metric.note: 'метрика' is a common alternative in analytics contexts; use 'показател' consistently with 'ключови показатели'.

due date.note: No due date = 'без краен срок'; Due = 'срок'.

assignee.note: 'изпълнител' is also natural but collides with run = 'изпълнение'; use 'отговорник' to keep the two distinct.

broadcast.note: Broadcast update = 'излъчване на актуализацията' (posting to additional channels).

attribute.note: Property fields on a playbook; same word as profile attributes — context disambiguates.

run summary.note: 'резюме' for the editable description; keep 'обобщение' for AI-generated summaries (recap, meeting summary).
